title: A Mathematical Theory of Communication: Core Argument Plan
subtitle: From Discrete Noiseless Systems to Continuous Channels with Fidelity Constraints

nodes.title: Definition of the Communication Problem and Logarithmic Measure
nodes.purpose: Establish the engineering scope (reproducing messages, ignoring semantics) and justify the logarithmic measure (bits) for information based on engineering parameters and intuition.

nodes.title: General Communication System Model
nodes.purpose: Define the five essential components: Information Source, Transmitter, Channel, Receiver, Destination, and the role of Noise.

nodes.title: Capacity of Discrete Noiseless Channels
nodes.purpose: Define channel capacity $C$ as the asymptotic rate of allowed signals ($ rac{	ext{log} N(T)}{T}$) and derive calculation methods using characteristic equations for constrained sequences.

nodes.title: Information Source Modeling and Entropy Definition
nodes.purpose: Model sources as Markoff processes, define Ergodicity, and derive Entropy ($H = -	ext{sum } p_i 	ext{log } p_i$) as the unique measure of uncertainty/choice.

nodes.title: Fundamental Theorem for Noiseless Channels
nodes.purpose: Prove that a source with entropy $H$ can be encoded to transmit at rate $R 	o C$ (channel capacity) with arbitrarily small error, establishing $H$ as the required bit rate.

nodes.title: Channel Capacity with Noise and Equivocation
nodes.purpose: Introduce Equivocation ($H_y(x)$) as missing information, define Capacity $C = 	ext{max}(H(x) - H_y(x))$, and state the Fundamental Theorem for Noisy Channels (Theorem 11).

nodes.title: Continuous Ensembles and Entropy Power
nodes.purpose: Extend entropy to continuous distributions, address coordinate dependence, and define Entropy Power to compare non-Gaussian ensembles with white noise.

nodes.title: Capacity of Continuous Channels with Power Limitations
nodes.purpose: Derive the capacity formula $C = W 	ext{log}_2(1 + P/N)$ for band-limited channels with average power constraints and white thermal noise.

nodes.title: Rate for Continuous Sources with Fidelity Criteria
nodes.purpose: Define the Rate $R$ relative to a fidelity evaluation function (distortion), establishing the minimum bit rate required to reproduce a continuous source within a specific tolerance.

nodes.title: Channel Capacity with Peak Power Limitations
nodes.purpose: Analyze the bounds on capacity when the transmitter is limited by peak instantaneous power rather than average power, showing asymptotic behavior for large signal-to-noise ratios.

coverage_notes: The plan follows the paper's structure: Part I (Discrete Noiseless), Part II (Discrete Noisy), Part III (Mathematical Preliminaries/Continuous), Part IV (Continuous Channel), and Part V (Rate for Continuous Source).
Core formulas such as $H = -	ext{sum } p_i 	ext{log } p_i$, $C = 	ext{max}(H(x) - H_y(x))$, and $C = W 	ext{log}(1 + P/N)$ are explicitly covered in required nodes.
The distinction between ergodic and mixed sources is included in the source modeling node as it underpins the statistical assumptions for the theorems.
The transition from discrete to continuous via limiting processes and entropy power is captured to ensure the continuous channel derivation is grounded.
